questions.stem: \(f : X \rightarrow Y\) will be an onto function if and only if its range is

hi.stem: \(f : X \rightarrow Y\) एक आच्छादक फलन होगा यदि और केवल यदि \(f\) का परिसर हो

questions.stem: The value of \(\cos(\sec^{-1} x + \operatorname{cosec}^{-1} x)\), \(|x| \ge 1\) is

hi.stem: \(\cos(\sec^{-1} x + \operatorname{cosec}^{-1} x)\), \(|x| \ge 1\) का मान है

questions.stem: For which value of \(\lambda\) is the vector \(2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \lambda\hat{k}\) perpendicular to the vector \(\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} + \hat{k}\) ?

hi.stem: \(\lambda\) के किस मान के लिए सदिश \(2\hat{i} + \hat{j} - \lambda\hat{k}\) सदिश \(\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} + \hat{k}\) पर लम्बवत् है ?

questions._flag: A serial stamp covers the Hindi lambda k-hat term; read from the clear English print.

questions.stem: The value of the integral \(\int \frac{\sin^2 x - \cos^2 x}{\sin^2 x \cos^2 x}\,dx\) is

hi.stem: समाकल \(\int \frac{\sin^2 x - \cos^2 x}{\sin^2 x \cos^2 x}\,dx\) का मान है

questions.subtopic: Order and Degree of a Differential Equation
questions.stem:
The order of the differential equation
\(x\left(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}\right)^2 + \sin x\left(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right)^3 + \left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)^4 + y^5 = 0\) is

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \(x\left(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}\right)^2 + \sin x\left(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}\right)^3 + \left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)^4 + y^5 = 0\) की कोटि है

questions._flag: A serial stamp crosses the Hindi d^2y/dx^2 term; read from the clear English print.

questions.subtopic: Derivatives of Functions in Parametric Form
questions.stem: If \(x = at^2\), \(y = 2at\), find the value of \(\frac{dy}{dx}\).

hi.stem: यदि \(x = at^2\), \(y = 2at\), तो \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Find the general solution of \(\frac{dy}{dx} = (1 + x^2)(1 + y^2)\).

hi.stem: \(\frac{dy}{dx} = (1 + x^2)(1 + y^2)\) का व्यापक हल ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Integrate \(x \log x\) with respect to \(x\).

hi.stem: \(x\) के सापेक्ष \(x \log x\) का समाकलन कीजिए।

questions.stem: Prove that \(f(x) = \tan x\) is a continuous function.

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(f(x) = \tan x\) एक सतत् फलन है।

questions.stem:
A relation \(R\) is defined in \(N \times N\) as follows :
\((a, b) R (c, d)\) if and only if \(ad = bc\).
Prove that \(R\) is an equivalence relation.

hi.stem:
\(N \times N\) में एक सम्बन्ध \(R\) निम्नवत् परिभाषित है :
\((a, b) R (c, d)\) यदि और केवल यदि \(ad = bc\).
सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(R\) एक तुल्यता सम्बन्ध है।

questions._flag: A serial stamp covers the first N of N x N and the ad in the English print; read from the clear Hindi print.

questions.stem: Evaluate : \(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{2x - x^2}}\,dx\).

hi.stem: \(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{2x - x^2}}\,dx\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Show that the points A, B and C, whose position vectors are respectively \(\vec{a} = 3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\), \(\vec{b} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\) and \(\vec{c} = \hat{i} - 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}\) form the vertices of a right-angled triangle.

hi.stem: दर्शाइए कि बिन्दु A, B और C, जिनके स्थिति सदिश क्रमशः \(\vec{a} = 3\hat{i} - 4\hat{j} - 4\hat{k}\), \(\vec{b} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j} + \hat{k}\) और \(\vec{c} = \hat{i} - 3\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}\) हैं, एक समकोण त्रिभुज के शीर्षों की रचना करते हैं।

questions._flag: A serial stamp covers the English B and the -j term of vector b; read from the clear Hindi print.

questions.stem: If \(2\begin{bmatrix} x & 5 \\ 7 & y - 3 \end{bmatrix} + \begin{bmatrix} 3 & -4 \\ 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 7 & 6 \\ 15 & 10 \end{bmatrix}\), find the values of \(x\) and \(y\).

hi.stem: यदि \(2\begin{bmatrix} x & 5 \\ 7 & y - 3 \end{bmatrix} + \begin{bmatrix} 3 & -4 \\ 1 & 2 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 7 & 6 \\ 15 & 10 \end{bmatrix}\), तो \(x\) तथा \(y\) के मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions._flag: Stamps cross the 15 in the Hindi print and the 10 in the English print; each is clear in the other language.

questions.stem: The length \(x\) of a rectangle is decreasing at the rate of 3 cm/min and the breadth \(y\) is increasing at the rate of 2 cm/min. When \(x = 5\) cm and \(y = 3\) cm, find the rate of change of the area of the rectangle.

hi.stem: किसी आयत की लम्बाई \(x\), 3 सेमी/मिनट की दर से घट रही है और चौड़ाई \(y\), 2 सेमी/मिनट की दर से बढ़ रही है। जब \(x = 5\) सेमी और \(y = 3\) सेमी, तो आयत के क्षेत्रफल में परिवर्तन की दर ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions._flag: The English print is faded: the opening 'The' and the 'the' before breadth were completed from the Hindi; the Hindi 3 semi/minute is stamped and read from the English.

questions.stem: Verify that the function \(y = a\cos x + b\sin x\) in which \(a, b \in R\), is a solution of the differential equation \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + y = 0\).

hi.stem: सत्यापित कीजिए कि फलन \(y = a\cos x + b\sin x\), जिसमें \(a, b \in R\), अवकल समीकरण \(\frac{d^2y}{dx^2} + y = 0\) का हल है।

questions.stem: Prove that if \(E\) and \(F\) are independent events, then \(E\) and \(F'\) will also be independent.

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि यदि \(E\) और \(F\) स्वतन्त्र घटनायें हैं, तो \(E\) और \(F'\) भी स्वतन्त्र होंगी।

questions.stem: Find the value of the determinant \(\begin{vmatrix} 17 & 15 & 13 \\ 9 & -8 & 7 \\ -3 & 2 & 5 \end{vmatrix}\).

hi.stem: सारणिक \(\begin{vmatrix} 17 & 15 & 13 \\ 9 & -8 & 7 \\ -3 & 2 & 5 \end{vmatrix}\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions._flag: A serial stamp covers the Hindi tan^{-1} 63/16; read from the English print.

questions.subtopic: Derivatives of Functions in Parametric Form
questions.stem: If \(x = a\sin^3 t\), \(y = b\cos^3 t\), then find \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) at the point \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\).

hi.stem: यदि \(x = a\sin^3 t\), \(y = b\cos^3 t\) तो बिन्दु \(t = \frac{\pi}{2}\) पर \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions._flag: Stamps cross the Hindi word बिन्दु and the English word find; each is clear in the other language.

questions.stem: Let three vectors \(\vec{a}\), \(\vec{b}\) and \(\vec{c}\) be such that \(|\vec{a}| = 3\), \(|\vec{b}| = 4\), \(|\vec{c}| = 5\) and each of them is perpendicular to the sum of the other two vectors, then find the value of \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}|\).

hi.stem: मान लीजिए \(\vec{a}\), \(\vec{b}\) और \(\vec{c}\) तीन सदिश इस प्रकार हैं कि \(|\vec{a}| = 3\), \(|\vec{b}| = 4\), \(|\vec{c}| = 5\) और इनमें से प्रत्येक, अन्य दो सदिशों के योगफल पर लम्बवत् है, तो \(|\vec{a} + \vec{b} + \vec{c}|\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Find the particular solution of \(x^2\,dy + \frac{1}{2}(xy + y^2)\,dx = 0\), given that \(y = 1\) when \(x = 1\).
questions._flag: A serial stamp crosses the Hindi word विशिष्ट; the reading is settled by the English 'particular solution'.

questions.subtopic: Equation of a Line in Space
questions.stem: Find the Cartesian equation of that line which passes through the point \((-1, 4, -5)\) and parallel to \(\frac{x+3}{3} = \frac{y-4}{5} = \frac{z-8}{6}\).

hi.stem: उस रेखा का कार्तीय समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जो बिन्दु \((-1, 4, -5)\) से जाती है और \(\frac{x+3}{3} = \frac{y-4}{5} = \frac{z-8}{6}\) के समान्तर है।

questions.subtopic: Graphical Solution and the Feasible Region
questions.stem: Maximize \(Z = 105x + 90y\) under the constraints \(2x + y \le 80\), \(x + y \le 50\), \(x \ge 0\), \(y \ge 0\) by graphical method.

hi.stem: व्यवरोधों \(2x + y \le 80\), \(x + y \le 50\), \(x \ge 0\), \(y \ge 0\) के अन्तर्गत \(Z = 105x + 90y\) का अधिकतमीकरण ग्राफीय विधि से ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: It is given that the numbers obtained on throwing two dice are different. Find the probability that the sum of both numbers is 4.

hi.stem: यह दिया गया है कि दो पासों को फेंकने पर प्राप्त संख्यायें भिन्न-भिन्न हैं। दोनों संख्याओं का योग 4 होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Solve the differential equation \(y\,dx + (x - y^2)\,dy = 0\).

hi.stem: अवकल समीकरण \(y\,dx + (x - y^2)\,dy = 0\) को हल कीजिए।

questions._flag: The English print of this part (and its marks) is badly faded; the equation was read with the clear Hindi print, and the 5 marks from the Hindi.

questions.stem: If the position vectors of the vertices A, B, C of a \(\Delta ABC\) are respectively \(\vec{a}\), \(\vec{b}\) and \(\vec{c}\) then prove that the area of \(\Delta ABC\) will be \(\frac{1}{2}|\vec{a} \times \vec{b} + \vec{b} \times \vec{c} + \vec{c} \times \vec{a}|\).

hi.stem: यदि किसी \(\Delta ABC\) के शीर्ष A, B, C के स्थिति सदिश क्रमशः \(\vec{a}\), \(\vec{b}\) और \(\vec{c}\) हैं, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(\Delta ABC\) का क्षेत्रफल \(\frac{1}{2}|\vec{a} \times \vec{b} + \vec{b} \times \vec{c} + \vec{c} \times \vec{a}|\) होगा।

questions._flag: The English print is faded at the right edge: 'respectively' and 'will be' were completed from the Hindi, and the 5 marks are read from the Hindi.

questions.stem:
Solve by matrix method the system of equations :
\(x - y + 2z = 7\)
\(3x + 4y - 5z = -5\)
\(2x - y + 3z = 12\)

hi.stem:
समीकरण निकाय
\(x - y + 2z = 7\)
\(3x + 4y - 5z = -5\)
\(2x - y + 3z = 12\)
को आव्यूह विधि से हल कीजिए।

questions.subtopic: Adjoint and Inverse of a Matrix
questions.stem: Prove that the matrix \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\) satisfies the equation \(A^2 - 6A + 11I = O\), where \(I\) is the identity matrix of order 2 × 2 and \(O\) is the zero matrix of order 2 × 2. With the help of it find \(A^{-1}\).

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि आव्यूह \(A = \begin{bmatrix} 2 & -1 \\ 3 & 4 \end{bmatrix}\) समीकरण \(A^2 - 6A + 11I = O\) को सन्तुष्ट करता है, जहाँ \(I\) कोटि 2 × 2 का तत्समक आव्यूह है और \(O\) कोटि 2 × 2 का शून्य आव्यूह है। इसकी सहायता से \(A^{-1}\) ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Prove that the height of the cylinder of maximum volume inscribed in a right circular cone of semi-vertical angle \(\alpha\) and height \(h\) is one-third of the height of the cone and the maximum volume of the cylinder is \(\frac{4}{27}\pi h^3 \tan^2 \alpha\).

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि अर्द्धशीर्ष कोण \(\alpha\) और ऊँचाई \(h\) के लम्ब वृत्तीय शंकु के अन्तर्गत अधिकतम आयतन के बेलन की ऊँचाई, शंकु की ऊँचाई की एक तिहाई है और बेलन का अधिकतम आयतन \(\frac{4}{27}\pi h^3 \tan^2 \alpha\) है।

questions.stem: Prove that \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x\,dx = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\).

hi.stem: सिद्ध कीजिए कि \(\int_0^{\pi/2} \log \sin x\,dx = -\frac{\pi}{2}\log 2\).

questions.stem: Find the area of the circle \((x - 2)^2 + y^2 = 4\).

hi.stem: वृत्त \((x - 2)^2 + y^2 = 4\) का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

questions.stem: Find the value of \(\int \left(\sqrt{\cot x} + \sqrt{\tan x}\right)dx\).

hi.stem: \(\int \left(\sqrt{\cot x} + \sqrt{\tan x}\right)dx\) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
